definitions.explanation: A swimming stroke performed face-down with alternating arm strokes and a flutter kick. The fastest and most commonly used stroke, also called freestyle in competitive swimming.

examples.japanese: クロールは{最|もっと}も{速|はや}い{泳法|えいほう}だ。
examples.english: The front crawl is the fastest swimming stroke.

examples.japanese: {水泳|すいえい}{教室|きょうしつ}でまずクロールを{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned the front crawl first at swimming class.

examples.japanese: クロールで25メートル{泳|およ}げるようになった。
examples.english: I can now swim 25 meters doing the front crawl.

notes:
TERMINOLOGY:
・クロール (crawl) - refers to the stroke technique
・{自由形|じゆうがた} (freestyle) - competitive event name where any stroke is allowed (but crawl is always used as it's fastest)

TECHNIQUE TERMS:
・{息継|いきつ}ぎ (breathing technique)
・バタ{足|あし} (flutter kick)
・ストローク (arm stroke)
・{手|て}のかき (arm pull)

FOUR SWIMMING STROKES ({4泳法|よんえいほう}):
・クロール/{自由形|じゆうがた} (freestyle/front crawl)
・{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (breaststroke)
・{背泳|せおよ}ぎ (backstroke)
・バタフライ (butterfly)

COLLOCATIONS:
・クロールを{泳|およ}ぐ (to swim front crawl)
・クロールで{泳|およ}ぐ (to swim using front crawl)
・クロールの{息継|いきつ}ぎ (breathing in crawl)
